questions.question: Mendel proposed the law of independent assortment on the basis of __________.

Consider the following statements and select the most appropriate answer.Statement I: According to Article 343(1), the official language of the Union shall be Hindi in Devanagari script.Statement II: According to Article 348(1), all Supreme Court proceedings and every High Court proceeding shall be in English.
options: Both statements I and II are correct.
Both statements I and II are incorrect.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Both statements I and II are correct.) है।

questions.question: What is the name of India’s first government-backed OTT platform launched by Kerala?

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Pirul Lao-Paise Pao) है।

questions.question: Which of the following provisions is made by Article 322 of the Indian Constitution?
options: Power to make regulations as to conditions of service of members and staff of the Commission
Power to extend functions of Public Service Commissions
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Expenses of Public Service Commissions) है।

questions.question: Who among the following married Kumara Devi, a Lichchavi princess?
What is the chronological span of the Middle Kingdoms in India?
options: The period began after the Satavahana decline and ended circa 1200 CE.
The period began after the Maurya decline and ended circa 1200 CE, lasting for about 1,500 years.
The period began after the Gupta decline and ended circa 1500 CE, lasting for about 9,000 years.
The period began after the Maurya decline and ended circa 1500 CE, lasting for about 1,800 years.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (The period began after the Maurya decline and ended circa 1200 CE, lasting for about 1,500 years.) है।
